sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Blades of Khorne army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Blades ofKhorne units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/ or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Pick an archetype.
4. Pick an origin and/or flaw.
5. Pick a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Bloodbutcher | 10 | 150
Gore Chieftain | 30 | 250
Brass Overlord | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.text: To begin with, your hero has the following warscroll:

sections.name: Step 3 - Pick an Archetype
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:
Khornate Warlord
-2DP
Your hero gains the BLOODBOUND keyword and the regiment options below. In addition, change your hero’s Save characteristic to 3+ and change their melee weapon to the profile below:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Great Blood-slick Weapon
Blood-hungry, Crit (2 Hits) | 5 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
Regiment Options | Any BLOODBOUND units
Daemon of Violence
-2DP
Your hero gains the DAEMON keyword and the regiment options below. In addition, your hero has WARD (6+) and change their melee weapon to the profile below:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Bloodshed Blade
Blood-hungry, Crit (2 Hits) | 5 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
Regiment Options | Any BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON units
Priest of Khorne
-4DP
Your hero gains the BLOODBOUND and PRIEST (1) keywords and the regiment options below:
Regiment Options | Any BLOODBOUND units
Locus of Battle
-2DP
Your hero gains the BLOODBOUND keyword and the regiment options below. In addition, change your hero’s Save characteristic to 3+.
Regiment Options | Any BLADES OF KHORNE units
Scorched Acolyte
-4DP
Your hero gains the DAEMON and PRIEST (1) keywords and has the regiment options below. In addition, your hero has WARD (6+).
Regiment Options | Any BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Passive
-2DP
TITAN SLAYER
Effect: This unit cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.
Passive
-2DP
RED RAIDER
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit if it charged in the same turn.
Passive
-2DP
HUNTER OF SOULS
Effect: You can re-roll run rolls for this unit.
Passive
-6DP
DEVOTED FOLLOWERS
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-HERO unit, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 6" away.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+2DP
A TRUE BERSERKER
Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1 that cannot be modified.
Passive
+3DP
WILLING SACRIFICE
Effect: This unit cannot be healed.
End of Any Turn
+4DP
KHORNE'S RETRIBUTION
Declare: This unit must use this ability.
Effect: If an enemy unit has not been destroyed by this unit this battle, inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit.
End of Any Turn
+4DP
KIN-KILLER
Declare: This unit must use this ability.
Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on every other friendly unit within 3" of this unit.

sections.name: Step 5 - Pick a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-5DP
BLOOD THRONE: Roaring, howling daemon engines with a taste for flesh, the Blood Thrones make for a fearsome sight.
Add the following weapon to your hero's warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Daemon Rider’s Hellblades
Blood-hungry, Companion | 4 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero's warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 8".
Change the Health characteristic to 10.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the WAR MACHINE keyword.
Battle Mount
-5DP
JUGGERNAUT: A clanking, daemonic beast of brass and iron, a Juggernaut must be coaxed from the depths of the Brass Citadel. To force one into servitude is a true test of will.
Add the following weapon to your hero's warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Juggernaut's Brass-shod Hooves
Companion | 2 | 4+ | 3+ | 1 | D3
In addition, make the following changes to your hero's warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
If this unit is BLOODBOUND, change the Save characteristic to 2+.
If this unit is DAEMON, change the Save characteristic to 3+.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.

sections.name: Step 6 - Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades
sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of Battle Mount Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Furious Haste
-2DP
Add 2" to your hero's Move characteristic.
Spikes and Blades
-2DP
Your hero’s Companion weapons have Crit (Mortal).
Studded Brass Hide
-3DP
Add 2 to your hero's Health characteristic.
Pulverising Charge
-4DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Any Charge Phase
PULVERISING CHARGE
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within l" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Anathemic Runescars
-4DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Passive
ANATHEMIC RUNESCARS
Effect: The unit has WARD (4+) against damage inflicted by SPELL abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.
Eager Killer
-5DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this hero
EAGER KILLER
Effect: Add D3 to the charge roll.
Anointed with Gore
-5DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Any Combat Phase
ANOINTED WITH GORE
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

sections.name: Step 7 - Pick any Other Upgrades
sections.text:
Pick any number of other upgrades for your hero. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Trophy Racks
-1DP
Add 2 to your hero's Control characteristic.
Killer's Heirloom
-2DP
The Wound characteristic of your hero’s Blood-slick Weapon is 3+.
Slaughterous Speed
-2DP
INFANTRY only. Add 1" to your hero’s Move characteristic.
Preferred Prey
-3DP
Your hero’s melee weapon has Anti-X (+1 Rend), where X is 1 of the following keywords: INFANTRY, CAVALRY, MONSTER, WAR MACHINE, WIZARD or PRIEST.
Blood-crazed Stare
-2DP
Your hero cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.
Brass Collar
-4DP
Subtract 1 from casting rolls for WIZARDS while they are within 12" of your hero.
Leathery Wings
-4DP
INFANTRY only. Your hero has FLY.
Ensorcelled Plate
-5DP
Non-CAVALRY only. Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target your hero.
Ruthless Savagery
-6DP
Your hero has the following ability:
Passive
RUTHLESS SAVAGERY
Effect: If an unmodified charge roll for this unit was 8+, it has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.
Blind to all but Hate
-6DP
Your hero has the following ability:
End of Enemy Turn
BLIND TO ALL BUT HATE
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that destroyed a friendly unit this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit.
Butcher's Brawn
-6DP
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of your hero’s non-Companion melee weapons.
Bloody Prophet
-6DP
PRIEST only. Add 1 to chanting rolls and banishment rolls for your hero.

sections.name: Path of The Slaughterer
sections.text:
(BLADES OF KHORNE HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Reaction: Opponent declared a FIGHT ability for a unit in combat with this unit
INVIGORATED BY WRATH
Effect: This unit can immediately make a pile-in move.
Reaction: This unit was targeted by a FIGHT ability
BLOOD-BLIND
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, after that FIGHT ability has been resolved, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy unit using that FIGHT ability equal to the roll.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BRUTAL ONSLAUGHT
Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.
Reaction: Your Movement Phase
DOMINATING POWERHOUSE
Effect: This unit can move D6". It must end that move in combat.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BREAKER OF THE ARCANE
Effect: This unit can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). Each time this unit unbinds a spell, subtract 1 from the power level of the WIZARD using that SPELL ability, to a minimum of 0, for the rest of the battle.
An enemy WIZARD can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a PRAYER ability for a PRIEST within 12" of this unit
LOCUS OF RED DEVOTION
Effect: The chanting roll must be re-rolled.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
VESSEL OF MURDER
Declare: Pick all enemy units in combat with this unit to be targets.
Effect: Roll 8 dice. For each roll of 3-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. For each 6, inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
WHIRLWIND OF ANNIHILATION
Effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

sections.name: Path of Brazen Butchery
sections.text:
(non-HERO BLADES OF KHORNE unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SHIELD-BREAKERS
Effect: Enemy units in combat with this unit cannot use the’ All-out Defence’ command.
End of Any Turn
PACK OF MURDERERS
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target cannot use RETREAT abilities until the start of your next turn.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SAVAGE CONQUERORS
Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective that you do not control.
Passive
SOUL-EATING RAGE
Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SPELL-KILLERS
Effect: Enemy MANIFESTATIONS in combat with this unit have STRIKE-LAST.
Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
LOPING PURSUIT
Effect: If the charge roll was 5 or less, you can re-roll 1 of the dice.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick l of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
INFAMOUS WARCRY
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the result exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
REVENANTS IN RED
Effect: If any enemy units were destroyed this turn while they were in combat with this unit, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points this unit has.
